headline: Copper Falls to Six-Month Low Amid Stronger Dollar and AI Concerns
summary: London copper futures dropped below $5.90 per pound to their lowest level in nearly five months, pressured by a stronger U.S. dollar and growing uncertainty surrounding AI investments.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal and economic bellwether whose price is closely tied to global manufacturing demand and currency fluctuations.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: A stronger U.S. dollar and weakening demand expectations directly depress dollar-denominated industrial metal prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Broad macroeconomic strength in the greenback combined with cautious sentiment in industrial and tech sectors pushed copper prices down to multi-month lows.
